levers.label: Cloning a long-only perfect-hindsight oracle
levers.hypothesis: A network that imitates an oracle's perfect entries/exits learns the MECHANISM of a swing, not the price of any single coin.
levers.expects: Buy/sell signals that generalize across the 14 pooled cryptos.

levers.label: 30-day trend filter
levers.source: Consistency law (operator, 2026-08-19) — a direct survival lever in bear years
levers.hypothesis: Entering only in a 30d+ uptrend keeps the book flat in broad bear markets (2018, 2022), the consistency law's open problem.
levers.expects: Raise the WORST year; less loss in bear years.

levers.label: Sample-uniqueness weighting
levers.source: Lopez de Prado, Advances in Financial ML (ch. 4)
levers.hypothesis: Windows overlap heavily (one label per candle); weighting each swing equally (1/leg-duration) avoids overfitting the redundant long legs.
levers.expects: Less overfitting; higher worst year without hurting the sealed 2026 readout.

levers.label: Purged validation + embargo
levers.source: Lopez de Prado, Advances in Financial ML (ch. 7)
levers.hypothesis: The oracle labels are computed over the WHOLE series, so train bars next to the cut 'see' the future through the pivots; purging + embargoing them gives an honest validation to select on.
levers.expects: Close the gap between internal validation and the sealed 2026 readout.

levers.label: Network committee (bagging)
levers.source: Lopez de Prado (bagging in finance); general ML variance reduction
levers.hypothesis: Averaging N networks with different seeds cuts VARIANCE — the direct enemy of year-to-year consistency.
levers.expects: More stable years; less dependence on a single network's luck.

score_metric: worst calendar-year return + 0.10*CAGR (each year 2018..2025 an independent account; 2026 sealed)
